content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the deviation status and the preferred level, using two minimal operations: a narrow operator/number edit cutting the Company's non-renewal window to "30 days'" written notice (HDI's 90-day window preserved, and the "Termination Date" sentence left byte-for-byte intact), plus one short insertion requiring HDI to give a renewal reminder not less than 60 days before each anniversary. No price-uplift language was added, as the clause contains no renewal escalation mechanic.
